🛡️ Zero-Trust API Key & Webhook HMAC Security Control

1. Raw Secret One-Time Display

API Secret Keys are hashed using Argon2id. Raw secret keys are displayed only once upon creation and cannot be recovered from the database.

2. Anti-Replay Timestamp Window

All requests require X-TIMESTAMP (±300s SLA). Copied request payloads are rejected with 401 Unauthorized.

3. HMAC-SHA256 Payload Signature

Webhooks are signed using HMAC-SHA256 header X-PAY2PAY-SIGNATURE for end-to-end data integrity.
